newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures continue to drift lower.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures continue to drift lower.

text.p: Pressure from bumper grain crops in Britain and France kept the pressure on UK grain futures during Tuesday.
Wheat futures closed with values 0.65 to 0.30 stg down on a light turnover of 373 lots, while barley traded 122 lots before closing 0.50 to 0.65 stg lower.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat contract failed to trade.
Cash market traders reported no fob business in the UK, while delivered trade was light with milling wheat trading one to 1.50 stg down and feed wheat 0.50 stg below Monday's levels.
